description: Tekton Results performance — watcher ingestion latency, API load testing, and component resource usage across versions. Test ID 425.

panels.description: Rate at which the Results watcher ingests completed PipelineRuns into the Results API (records/sec). Higher indicates faster ingestion. Measured during the signing+ingestion phase of the test.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily_agg AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', start) AS day,
    CASE WHEN label_values ? '__deployment_nightly' AND (label_values->>'__deployment_nightly')::BOOLEAN = true THEN 'nightly' ELSE COALESCE(label_values->>'__deployment_version', 'unknown') END AS version,
    (label_values->>'__parameters_test_concurrent')::INTEGER AS concurrency,
    AVG((label_values->>'__results_PipelineRuns_ingestion_throughput')::DOUBLE PRECISION) AS throughput
  FROM data
  WHERE horreum_testid = 425
    AND $__timeFilter(start)
    AND CASE WHEN label_values ? '__deployment_nightly' AND (label_values->>'__deployment_nightly')::BOOLEAN = true THEN 'nightly' ELSE COALESCE(label_values->>'__deployment_version', 'unknown') END = '${version}'
    AND (label_values->>'__parameters_test_concurrent')::INTEGER IN ($concurrency)

    AND label_values ? '__results_PipelineRuns_ingestion_throughput'
  GROUP BY day, version, concurrency
)

SELECT
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM day) AS time,
  'throughput @ ' || version || ' / c' || concurrency AS metric,
  throughput AS value
FROM daily_agg


ORDER BY time, metric;

panels.description: Total PipelineRuns that completed successfully. The test creates PRs at a constant rate with 30 concurrent; all should succeed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily_agg AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', start) AS day,
    CASE WHEN label_values ? '__deployment_nightly' AND (label_values->>'__deployment_nightly')::BOOLEAN = true THEN 'nightly' ELSE COALESCE(label_values->>'__deployment_version', 'unknown') END AS version,
    (label_values->>'__parameters_test_concurrent')::INTEGER AS concurrency,
    AVG((label_values->>'__results_PipelineRuns_count_succeeded')::DOUBLE PRECISION) AS pr_succeeded
  FROM data
  WHERE horreum_testid = 425
    AND $__timeFilter(start)
    AND CASE WHEN label_values ? '__deployment_nightly' AND (label_values->>'__deployment_nightly')::BOOLEAN = true THEN 'nightly' ELSE COALESCE(label_values->>'__deployment_version', 'unknown') END = '${version}'
    AND (label_values->>'__parameters_test_concurrent')::INTEGER IN ($concurrency)

    AND label_values ? '__results_PipelineRuns_count_succeeded'
  GROUP BY day, version, concurrency
)

SELECT
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM day) AS time,
  'pr_succeeded @ ' || version || ' / c' || concurrency AS metric,
  pr_succeeded AS value
FROM daily_agg


ORDER BY time, metric;
